title: Introduce streaming invocation summarizer and cost fingerprint index
author: Sofia Chen
description:
Motivation: Long-running incidents and daily SRE triage showed two recurring pain points: (1) lots of noisy long traces that are expensive to store and hard to scan manually, and (2) recurring cost-patterns (microbursts, prefetch storms, inefficient KV cache patterns) that were visible in raw telemetry but difficult to search for. This PR introduces a lightweight streaming "invocation summarizer" that emits 1-2 line human-friendly summaries for sampled invocations along with a compact cost "fingerprint" index to rapidly group and search similar costly invocation shapes. The goal is to make long-tail cost/latency triage faster and reduce alert fatigue by surfacing representative samples and grouping related noise.

What this change does: a) New summarizer worker (services/observability/summarizer) that subscribes to the sampled-invocation topic, computes a deterministic 64-bit cost fingerprint (based on token-phase durations, kernel stalls, KV hit ratio, and model variant), and emits a summary payload: {fingerprint, short_summary, top_k_cost_components, score}. Summaries are intentionally compact (<= 1KB) to keep storage and index cost low. b) Cost fingerprint index (observability/indexer) is a small k-v index that stores recent fingerprint -> representative-summary mappings and counts. Index supports approximate time decay and quick lookups by fingerprint or by fuzzy-match on top_k_cost_components. c) Pipeline wiring: sampled-invocation -> summarizer -> fingerprint-index and a parallel light-weight metrics export so dashboards can pull representative samples per alert bucket. d) Dashboard and alert changes: added a "Summary Panel" that surfaces the top 5 fingerprints for the selected time window with links to the representative trace and suggested RCA tags. Adjusted noisy SLO alerts to consult the index and aggregate by fingerprint to avoid PageStorms when a single misbehaving client produces thousands of similar noisy traces. e) Opt-in rollout: feature flag telemetry.summarizer.enabled and a per-tenant sampling_threshold. Default off for low-usage tenants.

Implementation notes: - Deterministic fingerprint uses a hashed quantized vector of phase token counts, kernel_queue_time rounded to 10ms bins, and KV hit percentile. This preserves grouping by behavior while avoiding PII. - Summaries are generated using a concise template; we intentionally avoid running a secondary LLM for summaries to control cost/latency. - Index writes are bounded and shelf-storage uses a new compact protobuf to reduce GC and serialization overhead. - Added end-to-end harness in observability/test/replay that replays archived sampled-invocations to validate grouping fidelity and index TTL behavior.

Checklist: - [x] Summarizer service + tests - [x] Fingerprint index + retention policy - [x] Dashboard panels and saved queries - [x] Alert rule updates and unit tests - [x] Feature flag gating and migration docs - [x] Load testing (local bench and canary on staging)

Risks and mitigations: - Risk: fingerprint collisions could group distinct root causes. Mitigation: summaries include top_k_cost_components and a stable sample id; UI exposes raw trace so operators can drill down. - Risk: index write amplification at extreme scale. Mitigation: rate-limited backoff and probabilistic downsampling; we instrumented and tested at 5x projected peak.

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy summarizer and index in staging with feature flag on for QA cluster. 2) Canary in us-west-2 for 48h with telemetry.summarizer.enabled for 5% of tenants. Monitor index write QPS, memory, and representative-summary recall. 3) Gradual ramp to 50% with alert-suppression rules enabled, iterate on summary templates. 4) Full enable with default tenant_opt_in=false; provide self-serve toggle in Console.

Backwards compatibility: All outputs are additive; existing traces/alerts continue to work. Feature flagged by default.

release_notes: Added a streaming invocation summarizer and compact cost fingerprint index. New dashboard Summary Panel surfaces representative summaries for costly invocation patterns; SLO alerts aggregate by fingerprint to reduce duplicate paging. Feature is gated behind telemetry.summarizer.enabled and tenant opt-in. See docs/observability/summarizer.md for usage and knob details.
